inlines.v: BETHINK', v.t. pret. and pp.bethought. [be and think.] To call to mind; to recall or bring to recollection, reflection, or consideration; generally followed by a reciprocal pronoun, with of before the subject of thought. I have bethought myself of another fault. BETHINK', v.i. To have in recollection; to consider.
